description: The Expectation paper's final run of qwen3.8:27b (13 Nov 2026): temperature 0.4, reasoning low, max_tokens 32768, traffic and top-up in stage 1, known data only, the study's purpose map. Was expectation-paper/study-2026-11/skuld_config_vllm_qwen_low_traffic_topup.json (whose model was gemma4:31b; the runs passed --model qwen3.8:27b). Self-contained since 20 Nov 2026, when config.json took gemma's recommended sampling and thinking xhigh: it states every value the run had from config.json then. The purpose vocabulary is dpv-purposes 2.3, whose nodes the stage-1 prompts list (2.3.1, since Ratatoskr 0.32.0, adds one). Its prompts are those it was asked with (versions before 20 Nov 2026, when the context moved to the end; skuld/templates.py); the proposer's are not kept, since its generator 2 also leaves notices out.
